name: cite
need: Mark where a generated answer's facts come from: numbered markers that open their source, and the list of sources

--ds-cite-size.description: `.ds-cite`, `.ds-cite-list__number`: the marker's height at md (2px per size step)

labExempt.DS.cite.cardOf: a lookup: the card a marker names, no motion

physical..ds-cite__card: inset: script coordinates: --ds-cite-x from the left, as DS.position.place() writes them

ripple..ds-cite: an inline marker in running text, like a text link: no ripple and no press morph
ripple..ds-cite__title: a text link to the source (inline links are the exception to ripple and morph)
